idea-plugin.name: Diffinery
idea-plugin.description:
Work with Diffinery repositories in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand and the other JetBrains IDEs, as you do with GitHub repositories.

  • Clone from Diffinery. Get from Version Control lists Diffinery next to GitHub: your repositories and your organizations', with search, or paste owner/name.
  • Sign in with your passkey. The IDE opens diffinery.com in your browser, you approve the connection, and you're back in the IDE. Nothing to copy.
  • Push and pull without passwords. When Git asks for a password for Diffinery, the plugin answers with your signed-in account, and renews its token before it runs out.
  • Share Project on Diffinery. Publish a local Git repository as a new Diffinery repository.
  • Any Diffinery. diffinery.com or your own: choose Use another server… under the sign-in button.

Guide: Clone in JetBrains IDEs.
